requests.name: cylinder
requests.prompt:
Create a premium, physically believable studio photograph for Best Bottles' bare glass bottle family cards. Native portrait 4:5 composition; fill the whole image with a seamless matte bone background (#F5F3EF), with a delicate tonal daylight gradient. Neutral daylight from upper left, soft precise contact shadows, controlled dark edge reflections and luminous glass thickness. Crystal-clear crisp glass with visible walls and bases, no haze. Each bottle must feel photographed in this setting, not like a flat cutout pasted on it.
STRICT PRODUCT SOURCE: The first reference is a sheet of ORIGINAL catalog bottle body pixels at relative physical scale. Copy each body's exact silhouette, shoulder geometry, neck thread proportions, glass base thickness, flute pattern and color. All are EMPTY BARE BOTTLES, uncapped, open threaded mouths. NO caps, pumps, droppers, roller inserts, tubes, stoppers, liquid, logos, labels or added parts. Do not stylize or improve their shapes. The reference is geometry authority.
LAYOUT: compose a quiet, elegant small family collection on ONE very low rectangular material slab. Its top supports all bottles, front face is subtle, occupying only the lower 12–18% of the image. The tallest bottle ends near y=80%; keep all product outlines and the entire slab inside frame. Leave at least 12% margin on both sides of the bottle group and 14% above the tallest neck. Recompose spacing to suit portrait format: scale the entire group down uniformly when needed, NEVER crop a bottle or stretch its silhouette. Slight front-to-back offsets are acceptable, all bottles upright and immediately legible. No foliage, water, scenery, other props, text, border or graphic overlays.
FAMILY CYLINDER: exactly THREE clear cylinder bottles, the three shown in reference1. Left small 5mL height53mm diameter17mm; middle regular 9mL height70mm diameter20mm; right very SLIM tall9mL height106mm diameter18mm. The tall cylinder is not a wider 30mL bottle; preserve its long narrow silhouette and thick base. Height ratios53:70:106. One continuous low CURly MAPLE wood slab: pale warm blond wood with fine subtle transverse rippled chatoyance exactly like the second reference. Reference2 supplies wood texture only. Same bone backdrop neutral daylight, pale wood must not look orange.
